name: Cinecenter
notes: showtimes live on ticket.cinecenter.at (booking system embedded via iframe on /tagesprogramm and /wochenplan, not on the homepage itself); site only publishes ~1 week of regular showtimes plus occasional far-out single preview screenings (e.g. a 'Love Birds Filmreihe' date in October); price not per-show (only a general tiered price list on /preise), so price_min/price_text always null; category = film's Genre field from its detail page
